text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home after a day out, I'm
enjoying
the gentle sway of the train
when...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...up. Wake... up. Trai...ner...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um! Please wake up, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems I conked out in my seat! As I
regain my
bearings, I realize we've
arrived at the final stop.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No, don't be! I should have woken you
up sooner.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer? The next train won't arrive
for a
little while, so how about we go
take a break until
then?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I think I see a cafe over there! We
can order
something and take it easy!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wow... This place is so cozy. They have
tables out
in the garden too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Um... Since it looks like the seats are
free,
why don't we sit outside?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... What a lovely view. And the
breeze feels so
nice...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Now, what to order? They've got
sweet red
bean soup, anmitsu jelly,
and...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh! They have plum-flavored kelp tea!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... How about I order some for us to
share?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm sure you'll find it delicious! Trust me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Trusting her judgment, we drink the tea
outside.
It has just the right level of
sourness to provide a
little kick and
warms me all the way to my toes.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Really? I'm glad you like it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. A while back, some elderly ladies
I knew
taught me that this tea is great
for a pick-me-up!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, I used to
spend a lot of
time with the older folks
who lived in my
neighborhood when I
was young.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yup! I often helped my mom and the
other
members of the neighborhood
association.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
We'd have tea together after delivering
flyers,
and sometimes they even let me
play gateball
with them.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I learned all kinds of stuff, like how
increasing
your salt intake can relieve
fatigue, or that fresh
air can cure most
anything.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I thought some salty plum kelp tea and
fresh air
would help you feel better,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you fell asleep on the train, so
you must
be really, really tired!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I never imagined that she was so
concerned about
my well-being...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-you're welcome! I'm glad I could help!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Let me know whenever you feel tired
again. I'll
find a way to boost your
energy!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I mean, the best scenario is if you
didn't get
that tired in the first place, of
course!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Right! I'll pace myself, too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Having you worry about me will only tire
you out
even more.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And I want you to always be beaming
like a ray of
sunshine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Nishino Flower pledges to pace
herself
moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's no reason to push yourself too
hard!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure any tea we have together will
taste just as
great, even if you're not
tired!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Let me know whenever you want to drink
some.
I'll join you anytime!
